name: Killarney & the Ring of Kerry
summary: Base in Killarney and take the famous Ring slowly: Cahersiveen, Waterville, Sneem, and the long views over Kenmare River, with the national park's lakes and Muckross woods waiting for the days you don't want to drive at all.
highlights: Muckross and the Owengarriff river walk to Torc Waterfall
The view over Ballinskelligs Bay from above Waterville
Aghadoe at sunset, the lakes laid out below
